title: Remove legacy /v1/export endpoint
body: Deletes the v1 export endpoint, deprecated since March. Customers must use /v2/reports.

title: Speed up dashboard load
body: Caches the account summary query. Median dashboard load drops from 2.1s to 0.6s.

title: Fix CSV import for dates before 1970
body: Negative timestamps were rejected by the importer.
